title: chat.postMessage returns not_in_channel for a bot posting to a public channel
symptoms: channel_not_found for a private channel the bot was never invited to
Posting works in one channel but not another
cause: New Slack apps can only post where the bot is a member. Posting to any public channel without joining needs the chat:write.public scope, and private channels always need an invite.
fix: Add chat:write.public and reinstall, or call conversations.join for public channels. For private channels, invite the bot with /invite.
affected: Slack apps using granular bot scopes, as of 2026-10
